Nosotros.title: A strategic ally in digital transformation
Nosotros.historyText: At NEXATIXS, we believe technology should not only solve problems but become the engine that drives organizations' growth. Every project is an opportunity to innovate, connect people and processes, and build solutions that generate a real, lasting impact.
Nosotros.objectivesText: To provide comprehensive technology solutions that allow companies and institutions to optimize their processes, improve productivity, and accelerate their digital transformation through innovative, secure, and scalable technologies.
whyParagraphs: At NEXATIXS, we understand that technology is not an end in itself, but a tool to drive your organization's growth. We don't just implement solutions; we become a strategic ally that analyzes every need, designs tailored solutions, and supports our clients throughout the entire digital transformation process.

We stand out for combining innovation, experience, and commitment to deliver secure, scalable, results-oriented technology solutions. Every project is developed under high quality standards, with a vision focused on efficiency, operational continuity, and our clients' sustainable growth.

Our strength lies in integrating multiple areas of technology — software development, infrastructure, networking, cloud computing, cybersecurity, automation, and artificial intelligence — to build complete solutions that optimize processes, reduce costs, and improve productivity.

At NEXATIXS, we believe in long-term relationships. That's why we provide close, transparent, and proactive service, offering specialized advice, continuous support, and ongoing guidance to ensure every technology investment generates maximum value for our clients.
More than implementing technology, at NEXATIXS we build trust, drive innovation, and create solutions that prepare organizations for the challenges of the future.

privacy.title: NEXATIXS Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you voluntarily provide, including but not limited to: full name, company name, email address, phone number, and the answers you provide in our Technology Discovery Form. If you are an active client with access to the Client Portal, we also process data related to your use of our services (support tickets, project status, contracted licenses).

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of processing
sections.body: We use your data to: (a) evaluate your service request and contact you to schedule a virtual interview, (b) generate and track your unique project identifier, (c) provide technical support through our Client Portal if you become an active client, (d) communicate with you about updates to your project or licenses, and (e) improve our services.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and security
sections.body: Your data is stored in a database infrastructure with access controls (Supabase/PostgreSQL), applying Row Level Security policies so that only you and authorized NEXATIXS personnel can access your information. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: 4. Third parties involved in processing
sections.body: We use Calendly to schedule virtual interviews; we use the Claude API (Anthropic) for virtual assistance features within the Client Portal. These providers process data only to the extent necessary to provide such functionality.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
sections.body: You may request at any time: access to the data we hold about you, correction of inaccurate data, or deletion of your data (unless there is a legal or contractual obligation to retain it), by writing to soporte@nexatixs.com.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
sections.body: We retain the data of prospects who do not move forward with a contract for a reasonable period for commercial follow-up purposes, and the data of active clients for the duration of the contract and the subsequent period required by legal or accounting obligations.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy periodically. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of the document.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: For any questions about this policy, please write to us at soporte@nexatixs.com.

terms.title: NEXATIXS Terms of Service

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This site provides information about NEXATIXS's technology services and allows prospects to start a technology evaluation, as well as active clients to access a portal for managing their projects, licenses, and technical support.

sections.heading: 2. Use of the site
sections.body: You agree to use this site lawfully, without attempting to compromise its security, without extracting or reusing content for commercial purposes without authorization, and by providing truthful information in the Discovery Form and in your Client Portal account.

sections.heading: 3. Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on this site (text, logos, design, code) is the property of NEXATIXS or its licensors, and may not be reproduced without prior written authorization.

sections.heading: 4. Nature of the Discovery Form
sections.body: Submitting the Discovery Form does not constitute a service contract or an obligation to contract for either party. It is an initial evaluation tool that may or may not lead to a formal commercial proposal.

sections.heading: 5. Client Portal
sections.body: Access to the Client Portal is reserved for individuals with an active account associated with a current contract with NEXATIXS. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your access credentials.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
sections.body: NEXATIXS does not guarantee that the site will be free of errors or interruptions. The provision of contracted services will be governed by the contract or quote signed independently between NEXATIXS and the client, not by these Terms of Service.

sections.heading: 7. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Dominican Republic.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, please write to us at soporte@nexatixs.com.
